security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, if an aligned memory instruction accessing ≤XLEN (64) bits is decomposed across DCache banks or split into multiple TileLink transactions without coherent atomicity guarantees, the single memory operation rule is violated. Specifically: (1) the DCache MainPipe's unalign bank-split path (NewLoadUnit.scala:1750-1803) decomposes an aligned but cross-bank access into two separate DCache reads that may be interleaved with remote hart stores; (2) the AtomicsUnit FSM for AMOCAS.Q issues 2 sta uops (AtomicsUnit.scala:86-99) for a 128-bit (>XLEN) operation but emits a single M_XA_CASQ DCache command (MainPipe.scala:724-800) — on a cache miss, the MissQueue (MissQueue.scala:56,590) lacks explicit 128-bit atomic TileLink handling, so a decomposed fallback path could violate single-copy atomicity if it silently splits the CAS into two 64-bit bus transactions.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: search for: (1) DCache main pipe code paths where `s3_req.miss && s3_req.isAMO` triggers MissQueue enqueue without CASQ-specific atomicity on the TileLink channel (MainPipe.scala:637,846-848; MissQueue.scala:56); (2) bank-split read paths where two dependent DCache reads (NewLoadUnit.scala:1799 `s3ShiftHead | s3ShiftTail`) serve a single aligned instruction and lack cache-line locking between the two reads; (3) any >XLEN-bit aligned memory operation (e.g., FLQ/FSQ, V-extension vector mem ops) that is decomposed into individual bank accesses without inter-access coherency locking
security_spec.summary: PR editorial: single-copy atomicity now keyed to XLEN threshold — XiangShan must ensure all aligned ≤XLEN-bit mem ops remain a single coherent memory operation; AMOCAS.Q (>XLEN on RV64) decomposition across uops must NOT leak intermediate state between the two sta uop halves when miss path falls through MissQueue
